question: What’s the closest hotel you pass going from Top of the Rock, New York, NY to Jay Heritage Center, Rye, NY?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.979395 40.759034)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.706068 40.95728)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'hotel'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.979395 40.759034)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.979395 40.759034)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: Top of the Rock, New York, NY
